application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey side infill and single storey rear extension and rear roof extension with three front roof lights to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (058-HH-101, 058-HH-102, 058-HH-103, 058-HH-104, 058-HH-105, Design and Access Statement, Fire Statement Received 26 October 2022; 058-HH-106 Rev 2, 058-HH-107 Rev 2, 058-HH-108 Rev 2 Received 21 December 2022)  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
